style.lock: ORIGINAL EVAVO early-1990s procedural VGA production. Grounded municipal observation, small proportionate actors, selective silhouette contrast, broad intentional pixel clusters, restrained material dithering, practical fluorescent/night lighting. Final runtime art is native 320x200-era pixel work, not modern pixel-art styling and not a retro filter.
style.continuity: Night officer wears practical dark navy duty uniform with restrained brown leather/equipment and natural skin values. Station is mundane municipal architecture with institutional fluorescent light. Preserve exact native geometry and all Adventure Studio pivot/foot/occlusion requirements.

modern cinematic bloom HDR chromatic aberration depth of field

style.originality: Historical Sierra/SCI1 production discipline is a process reference only. Draw wholly original EVAVO characters, station architecture, props and animation poses; do not reproduce proprietary art or bytes.

families.label: Night officer native performance strip
families.prompt: Original municipal night officer, east-facing, tiny early-90s VGA actor. Work directly at 20x46 rendered pixels with binary transparency, no antialiasing and no full-body outline. Preserve body mass, uniform/material clusters and stable floor contact across all poses.
families.continuity: All twelve frames share the same identity, proportions, uniform, palette roles, foot point, shadow anchor and hand attachment logic. Walk contact must not skate. Reach/inspect/notebook are economical one-beat poses.

subjects.label: Night officer
subjects.prompt: Anonymous original municipal night officer, average working posture, dark navy duty clothing and restrained leather equipment; no recognisable proprietary police-game character design.

clips.label: Idle
poses: grounded neutral duty stance, readable small silhouette, no hero pose
clips.prompt: Neutral idle pose. Feet planted, shoulders relaxed, hands economical, face readable only through intentional native clusters.

clips.label: Eight-frame walk
clips.prompt: Eight authored gait phases. Clean negative space between legs where needed, restrained head/torso bob, no tween-like smoothing. Frames 03 and 07 are the planted contacts.

clips.label: Practical reach
poses: one-arm practical reach for radio keys or latch, stable feet and body scale
clips.prompt: Short practical reach with one clear hand gesture; avoid noisy finger anatomy.

clips.label: Inspect
poses: brief attentive lean/read pose with stable foot anchor and clear gaze direction
clips.prompt: Economical inspect/read pose for briefing, vehicle observation or receipt.

clips.label: Notebook
poses: compact notebook-writing pose, one hand stabilises pad and other marks it
clips.prompt: Small readable notebook gesture with no oversized prop or cinematic pose.
